name: fortinet-mr-test
description: Find GitLab MRs labelled (e.g.) forge:stage::needs_review AND forge:keyword::automation_test → for each: build via Jenkins, upgrade a NAC in a TP lab to the new build, run the pytest case linked from the bug's Mantis description, post results back to the MR and flip the stage label to tested_passed / tested_failed. Two label-filter inputs are configurable (no hard-coded label strings).
author: forge
